verses.2:
the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;
 the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.3:
the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital;
 and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
verses.4:
These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months.
 And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
verses.5:
and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem:
 Shimea, + 3:5 Shimea is a variant of Shammua ; see 2 Samuel 5:14|2SA 5:14 and 1 Chronicles 14:4. Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba + 3:5 One Hebrew manuscript and Vulgate (see also LXX and 2 Samuel 11:3|2SA 11:3 ); most Hebrew manuscripts Bath-shua daughter of Ammiel. + 3:5 Ammiel is a variant of Eliam ; see 2 Samuel 11:3|2SA 11:3 .
verses.6: David’s other sons were Ibhar, + 3:6 Hebrew does not include David’s other sons were . Elishua, + 3:6 Two Hebrew manuscripts (see also 2 Samuel 5:15|2SA 5:15 and 1 Chronicles 14:5); most Hebrew manuscripts Elishama Eliphelet,
verses.8: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet— nine in all.
verses.9:
These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
 The Descendants of Solomon
verses.10:
Solomon’s son was Rehoboam:
 Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.11: Joram + 3:11 Joram is a variant spelling of Jehoram . his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.12: Amaziah his son, Azariah + 3:12 Azariah is also called Uzziah ; see 2 Chronicles 26:1|2CH 26:1 . his son, Jotham his son,
verses.13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.14: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.15:
The sons of Josiah:
 Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum + 3:15 Shallum is another name for Jehoahaz . the fourth.
verses.16:
The successors of Jehoiakim:
 Jeconiah + 3:16 Jeconiah is a variant of Jehoiachin ; also in verse 17; see 2 Kings 24:6|2KI 24:6 . his son, and Zedekiah.
 The Royal Line After the Exile
verses.17:
The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:
 Shealtiel his son,
verses.18: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.19:
The sons of Pedaiah:
 Zerubbabel and Shimei.
 The children of Zerubbabel:
 Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith,
verses.20: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
verses.21:
The descendants of Hananiah:
 Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
verses.22:
The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons:
 Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
verses.23:
The sons of Neariah:
 Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam— three in all.
verses.24:
The sons of Elioenai:
 Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani— seven in all.
